prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production 2D Mage survivor animation for Grave Accord. Image 1 is the approved four-view Mage identity reference. Image 2 is the approved complete four-pose idle strip for this same facing. It locks the exact camera, equipment hands, profile and haircut. Use its identity throughout the new action sheet. Keep the same young adult man, pale face, short tousled black hair with a shaved side, broad dark indigo-blue layered robe and shoulder cape, brown leather cross strap/belt, brown boots/gloves, ONE rigid brass sun-wheel staff in his physical LEFT hand, and one CLOSED brass-brown book tethered at his physical RIGHT hip. Right hand stays free. Preserve body proportions, the slightly elevated game camera, staff design and all asymmetric equipment. No extra staff, book, firearm, shield or weapon-hand change. Use restrained dry black ink and matte opaque gouache, broad quiet cloth planes and a few selective contours. Avoid glossy gradients, excessive scratches, decorative filigree, tiny noise, magic particles, glow or flashy effects. Maintain two connected arms and two legs, a rigid staff shaft and attached hands throughout.
Every pose faces WEST, screen LEFT, matching the lower-right reference. Keep the staff in the physical LEFT hand and the closed book at the physical RIGHT hip, both visible on the reference near side. Nose and boots keep pointing screen LEFT. Do not reuse a mirrored EAST drawing.
Draw exactly 2 complete full-body poses as one coherent hurt animation sheet, arranged in one horizontal row of 2 equal cells on a wide transparent canvas. Fill exactly these 2 cells with no extra figure. Action: A brief damage response while maintaining the EXACT WEST-facing LEFT profile from the approved idle strip. 1 a small knee/shoulder recoil, 2 recover the same full-height WEST ready pose. The LEFT profile has long tousled black fringe over the near temple/ear. The shaved side belongs to the OPPOSITE physical RIGHT side and must NOT suddenly appear on the WEST-facing near side. Do not mirror the EAST head. Both noses and boots point screen LEFT, torso never turns toward the viewer. Keep the LEFT-hand staff and tethered RIGHT-hip book unchanged. No gore, flash, wound or effect.
Use the full upright neutral pose as the common size reference; every frame shares one character scale. Keep roomy clear gutters and padding around EVERY full silhouette and the ENTIRE staff, plus a consistent ground baseline within each row. Crouched and lying bodies must retain their natural lower height, never be stretched to standing height. BACKGROUND: genuine RGBA transparency, alpha zero everywhere outside the figures, including between legs and around staff/book. No floor, ground shadow, scenery, haze, glow, vignette, colored backdrop, checker pattern, text, labels, numbers or grid lines. Preserve clean ink edges and matte gouache inside the silhouettes. Deliver the entire coherent sheet, never isolated unrelated illustrations.
